articles.title: LayerZero unveils trading infrastructure for crypto and tokenized markets, ZRO surges
articles.snippet: The trading infrastructure runs on LayerZero's Zero blockchain, backed by Citadel Securities with DTCC and ICE exploring institutional market applications.

articles.title: Morning Minute: LayerZero Announces ATLAS as New Settlement Engine
articles.snippet: The market liked the news, with ZRO up 10% and jumping nearly 50% off its local bottom.
